text:
mira: Pasting quick postmortem + playbook idea. We started seeing a ~2.3% increase in funcall json parse failures after onboarding talon-2b-int8 canary yesterday. Symptoms: truncated array suffix and occasional trailing commas.
jon: Oof. any example logs? :eyes:
mira: Sure, from canary run 2024-11-03 10:12 UTC:
```
WARN model-runtime talon-2b-int8: emitted 0x1b0 '..."actions": [{"name": "search", "args": {"q": "..."}},\n{"name": "open","args": {}}],\n]
'
ERROR parser funcall: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 123 (char 122)
```
priya: That trailing comma looks like generator stopping mid-token. Does FP64/FP16 run cleanly?
kevin: FP16 baseline had 0.03% failures on same traffic. So delta is large.
mira: My hypothesis: int8 decoding / tokenizer trimming interacts with KV-prefix batching so suffix tokens get clipped more often. Another possibility is sampling temperature not set to 0 during compare.
jon: We should run an audit playbook: deterministic replay -> shrink to minimal prompt -> compare token-level diffs across quant variants -> run targeted canary with prefix caching off.
priya: Agree. Proposed steps (short):
1) Collect N=200 failing traces and their original prompts (include model variant tags).
2) Replay with temperature=0, top_p=1, seed fixed, batch_size=1.
3) Run model in FP32/FP16/INT8 and capture raw token ids + tokenizer detokenized strings.
4) If mismatch, run with KV-cache disabled and "streaming:false".
5) Produce a token-diff heatmap and a small reparative heuristic (strip trailing commas / wrap in array) and measure recovery rate.
kevin: I'll add: tag runs with run_id and canary_label so we can join with observability traces.
mira: Quick command I used to replay single trace:
```
python tools/replay.py --run-id 20241103-1021 --seed 42 --temp 0 --variant talon-2b-int8 --no-kvcache --out tokens.json
```
jon: For immediate mitigation, can we enable soft-json-rescue for canary traffic? e.g., try parse -> if fail, apply regex fixes and retry up to 2x before returning error.
priya: We already have a repair hook but it's disabled for int8 canaries. I can flip it for one hour and watch.
deploy-bot: deploy started: enable-json-rescue (canary=talon-2b-int8) by priya. ETA 1m
mira: Also request bench: run eval harness on our 5 canonical toolcall prompts and record success rate + semantic fidelity (automated exact-match + human sampling).
kevin: I'll spin up the jobs, will attach results here. Early flag: we should avoid wide rollout until rescue and token-diff analysis are done.
priya: I'll collect the 200 traces and sanitize PII, sharing S3 link.
mira: Thanks. If we find consistent pattern we can add a token-level check in canary gating (fail if trailing incomplete-struct tokens > 0.5%).
jon: :thumbsup: Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT if not resolved.
priya: added calendar invite.
kevin: attaching first job id: run-20241103-01; will add outputs when ready.
mira: filing playbook doc after this thread. tl;dr — audit + deterministic replay + soft-rescue = immediate guardrails.
